summary: Forcepoint DDR continuously watches activity on sensitive files in the cloud and on endpoints and raises prioritized alerts as soon as signs of exfiltration appear.
value: Attempts to take sensitive files out are noticed during the file activity itself, not from someone else’s breach notice.
Alerts explain what data, who and what they did with it — making false positives easier to weed out.
Each alert comes with recommended response steps.
File movement history (lineage) speeds up leak investigations.
simple: Forcepoint DDR (Data Detection and Response) continuously tracks file activity — reads, shares, renames, moves — in cloud sources and on endpoints, classifies data with AI Mesh and detects signs of exfiltration. Alerts are prioritized by severity, with full context and recommended response steps; file movement history helps investigations. Works together with Forcepoint DSPM; on-prem, DDR is available only in some DSPM license options.
notIncluded: No discovery or cleanup of data in repositories — that is Forcepoint DSPM.
No policy-based blocking of data transfers by email, web or USB — that is Forcepoint DLP.
classification: Detecting attempts to exfiltrate sensitive data — DLP.
Analyzes actions on data, not the normal behavior of accounts — no UEBA, text only.
